## What and why

What this changes, and the real reason it's needed — a bug you hit, a gap
you found against a real site/API, a limitation that got in the way. Link
an issue if there is one.

## How this was verified

How you confirmed the fix/feature actually works — a new or updated test,
a real run against a real target, etc. `npm test` should pass cleanly
(aside from anything the CI machine itself can't run, e.g. browser-driven
tests with no Chromium installed).

## Anything deliberately left out

Anything you considered and decided not to do as part of this change, and
why — helps reviewers not re-litigate a call you already made.
